content:
Debugging FastAPI isn’t about finding a single bug; it’s about mastering the art of politely questioning your code’s every decision. Seriously, be nice to your functions! What’s your favorite debugging tactic?

#DebuggingFastAPI #FastAPIdev
reel_script:
Hook (0-3s): “Your FastAPI app is yelling at you?”

Scene 1 | Visual: Close-up of a frustrated developer slamming their keyboard. | Voiceover: "Debugging isn't about finding *the* bug. It’s about politely questioning every single thing your code does."

Scene 2 | Visual: Animated thought bubble above a line of code, with a tiny question mark popping up repeatedly. | Voiceover: "Seriously, did you *really* need that nested loop? Was that variable *really* the right type?"

Scene 3 | Visual: The frustrated developer now smiling calmly, sipping coffee, surrounded by code with helpful debugging tools. | Voiceover: “It’s about gentle persuasion. Become a code whisperer.”

Closing line: “Master the art of asking ‘Why?’ – your FastAPI will thank you.”
